rule: Return this JSON object with the rule field unchanged and, in the text field, the verse that comes immediately after the current text in the same song. Preserve exactly one concrete causal connection to the current verse. Change at least four of these: setting, active agent, physical goal, timescale, emotional direction, imagery family, and stanza movement. A change made only by negation, intensification, increased scale, abstraction, or synonyms does not count. Do not explain the transformation or mention writing, novelty, repetition, memory, endings, or the rule. Write exactly four lines of five to ten words each. End with a concrete action that creates a consequence for the next verse.
text: The tide came in an hour early.
